title: Azure Vacation Rental
meta_description: Azure is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionAzureWaterColor Beach CommunityPine Needle Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Home Highlights6 bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab for full layouts)6.5 bathroomsSleeps up to 14 guests4,500+ sq. ft. of indoor space2,000 sq. ft. of outdoor spaceOutdoor shower & gas grill6-seater golf cart includedFive spacious porchesParking for 3 vehiclesFour 26" adult bikes included seasonally (Dec–Feb not included; additional rentals available)Cheers to Cherished Times at Azure!Nestled in the serene Forest District of WaterColor, Azure seamlessly blends classic Florida charm with modern comfort. Bright white walls, cheerful furnishings, and coastal-blue accents create a warm, inviting atmosphere. With three sitting areas and five spacious porches, Azure is perfect for large family gatherings or quiet moments surrounded by nature. Framed by lush forest views, the home offers privacy and abundant outdoor space for everyone to enjoy.Inside AzureFirst Floor: Four beautifully appointed bedrooms, four bathrooms, a cozy sitting room, and a convenient laundry room.Second Floor: Main living area with open-concept design, plus two luxurious king suites.Third Floor: A kid-friendly retreat with plenty of space for play and relaxation.Fourth Floor: Staircase leads to the viewing deck, offering breathtaking panoramic views.WaterColor AmenitiesAs an Azure guest, enjoy exclusive access to the newly expanded Gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club with:Main pool with lounge areas & multiple decksZero-entry pool & sunset barDirect beach access with chair and umbrella rentalsPlus, Camp WaterColor features:Lazy river & two pools with water slidesSports courts, lifeguards, and poolside refreshmentsExplore WaterColor & BeyondWaterColor is a paradise for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts. Hike or bike trails, kayak, paddle-board, or enjoy tennis and pickleball. Nearby, the town offers art galleries, boutique shopping, and fantastic dining. Azure is more than a vacation rental—it’s where memories are made.Community AmenitiesMultiple community poolsCamp WaterColorPrivate community beach accessWaterColor Town Center with shopping & diningWestern Lake access (South Walton’s largest coastal dune lake)Playground, tennis & pickleball courtsMultiple parks, green spaces, and nature trailsWellness amenities at WaterColor Boathouse (fees may apply)Notes & Policies:WaterColor requires wristbands for guests 5+ years old for pool & beach access; provide accurate guest count at least 2 weeks prior.Golf cart rentals must be arranged via The Electric Cart Company; only one cart per home is permitted.Parking: 3 vehicle drivewayNO SMOKINGHome for saleNot Pet FriendlyCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years old.Two Ring cameras at front and side doors.Rates do not include tax & fees.50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior. 5% cancellation fee applies; full refund available for cancellations >60 days prior. Optional travel insurance available.
